messages:
kevin_pm: quick kickoff — want to propose an "acceptance sampler" flow for model onboarding + a tighter deprecation playbook. goal: catch regressions before customer impact and make pin/grace decisions predictable. thoughts?

maria_prod: yes please. we keep getting surprise QA noise during canaries. need clear launch gates and a short checklist we can hand to sales. :raised_hands:

josh_eng: +1. technical constraints: quantization compatibility and KV-cache drift are big sources of perf/quality delta. we should map model variants -> hardware buckets early.

olga_research: idea: require a tenant + global eval set. compute three signals: 1) semantic drift (cosine on embeddings), 2) conv-level accuracy on core prompts, 3) hallucination regressions via heuristics.

kevin_pm: rough thresholds proposal (open for pushback):
```
quality.cosine_delta <= 0.02   # average across core eval
quality.regression_rate <= 0.5%  # failures per 10k responses
latency.p95_delta_ms <= 10
```
canary plan: 1% traffic for 24h, 10% for 72h, then full. fallback: immediate pin and rollback to previous model variant.

tara_sre: operational ask: add automated alert when regression_rate > 0.25% during canary (so we stop early). we need a runbook snippet for rollbacks. also map which infra buckets to evict first.

nate_cs: from CS perspective customers want predictable grace: suggest a minimum pin window of 90 days for enterprise customers, with a 30-day expedited migration path if we provide a compat-shim. smaller tenants get 30-day pin. need language for contracts.

maria_prod: that sounds reasonable. propose we make pin exceptions bookable (sales intake) and capture migration commitment (engineer hours) in the ticket.

josh_eng: implementation notes:
- onboarding job generates per-tenant eval report + diff UI
- automatic flags: BLOCK if quality/cosine thresholds fail, WARN if latency threshold fails
- support phased rollouts + canary tag `canary-sampler-v1`

olga_research: add sampling guidance: sample 5000 queries from production traffic stratified by route and customer size. compare embeddings distribution with KS test + median cosine.

kevin_pm: launch criteria checklist (first pass):
- core eval pass (all signals within thresholds)
- canary plan verified (traffic % and monitoring hooks)
- infra mapping complete (hardware buckets assigned)
- CS migration & pin policy set for affected customers
- rollout runbook and rollback automation in place

maria_prod: also add docs: customer comm templates (what we say when we deprecate), and a migration checklist for customer success.

tara_sre: I can add the runbook fragment. sample alert rule: `alert: ModelCanaryQualityDrop` when regression_rate > 0.25% for 10m. include automatic annotation of offending model hash + tenant id.

kevin_pm: decision points we need to resolve before we call this RFC:
1) final numeric thresholds (olga to propose based on recent evals)
2) pin window by tier (maria + nate)
3) automation scope: block vs warn (eng + sres)
4) deprecation grace: default 60 days vs 90 enterprise

olga_research: I'll run a 30-day historical sweep and post recommended thresholds by EOD Friday.

josh_eng: engineering can wire the canary tag and auto-block logic in a spike next week. ETA: PR by Wed.

maria_prod: I'll draft the comm templates and the sales intake form.

nate_cs: CS ok to start drafting contract language for pins/exemptions. want to sync Tue.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline: canary-tagging feature branch `canary/sampler` passed unit tests and lint (build #4821). deploy to staging scheduled 1746040000.

kevin_pm: ok next steps: olga -> thresholds; josh -> spike + PR; tara -> runbook fragment; maria+nate -> pin windows + comms. we'll reconvene Thu AM to finalize RFC. thanks all. :rocket:
